important_distinction: DOCUMENT SHA-256 used in copied phrase proves which document the user ratified; it is not proposal SHA-256 and cannot replace V2 p_decision.propuesta_sha256.

Rule writer V2 requires a fresh parent RUN after or around the actual decision time and an exact governed_rule_patch, independent semantic PASS, verified source snapshot; calling APROBAR writes immediately.

For policies Q01/Q11/Q12 and central policy19 there is no established native policy V2 owner writer; chat phrase can only be recorded as a documentary conversation declaration, identity_verified stays false.
Sign-off of a documentary proposal does not waive unresolved security, QA, identity or promotion gates.
Admin1 and Admin2 same factor OTP/Brevo now; old L35 AUTH019 patch SHA should not be signed as it left admin1 undecided.
